name: The valentine
description: Short, warm and unhurried — a handful of chapters, a voice note and one question at the end.

defaults.title: For you, on Valentine's
defaults.openingMessage: A card felt like not enough this year.
defaults.closingMessage: That's all of it. I meant every word.

copy.envelope.title: Happy Valentine's.

content.text: Replace this with the reason you made it instead of buying one. One honest sentence beats three clever ones.
Things I don't say often enough
Three or four of them. Be specific — the way they make coffee, the thing they do when you're ill, the way they are with your family. Specific is what lands.
Replace this with something they said once that you never forgot.

content.title: A voice note
content.description: Record it in one take. The stumbles are the good part.
